verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and communications SaaS platform. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code availability, a public repository, or an open-source license; it covers only the API, the MCP server and product features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
